readings.title: One Altar for Atonement
readings.subtitle: The Prohibition of Blood
readings.text: [Leviticus 17:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to Aharon, to his sons, and to all the children of Yisra’el, and say to them, ‘This is the word which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has commanded, saying,</dq> [3] <dq>“Any man from the house of Yisra’el who slaughters a bull or a lamb or a goat in the camp, or who slaughters it outside the camp,</dq> [4] <dq>and does not bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to bring <dn>את</dn> an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> before the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, blood-guilt is reckoned to that man. He has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people,</dq> [5] <dq>in order that the children of Yisra’el bring <dn>את</dn> their slaughterings which they offer in the open field, that they shall bring them to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and offer <dn>את</dn> them as peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [6] <dq>“And the priest shall sprinkle <dn>את</dn> the blood on the altar of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [7] <dq>“And let them no longer slaughter <dn>את</dn> their slaughterings to goat-idols after which they go whoring. This is a law forever for them throughout their generations.” ’</dq> [8] <dq>“And say to them, ‘Any man of the house of Yisra’el, or of the strangers who sojourn among you, who offers a burnt offering or slaughtering,</dq> [9] <dq>and does not bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to do it to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, that man shall be cut off from his people.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And any man of the house of Yisra’el, or of the strangers who sojourn among you, who eats any blood, <dn>I</dn> shall set <dn>My</dn> face against that being who eats blood, and shall cut him off from among his people.</dq> [11] <dq>‘For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and <dn>I</dn> have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your lives, for it is the blood that makes atonement for the life.’</dq> [12] <dq>“Therefore <dn>I</dn> said to the children of Yisra’el, ‘No being among you eats blood, nor does any stranger who sojourns among you eat blood.’</dq> [13] <dq>“And any man of the children of Yisra’el, or of the strangers who sojourn among you, who hunts and catches any beast or bird that is eaten, shall pour out <dn>את</dn> its blood and cover it with dust,</dq> [14] <dq>for it is the life of all flesh. Its blood is for its life. And <dn>I</dn> said to the children of Yisra’el, ‘You do not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood. Anyone eating it is cut off.’</dq> [15] <dq>“And every being who eats a carcass or what was torn by a beast, be he a native or a stranger, he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening, then he shall be clean.</dq> [16] <dq>“But if he does not wash or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his crookedness.”</dq>

readings.title: Forbidden Relations
readings.subtitle: Preserving the Sanctity of the Family
readings.text: [Leviticus 18:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’el, and say to them, ‘<dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [3] <dq>‘Do not do according to the works of the land of Mitsrayim where you dwelt, and do not do according to the works of the land of Kena’an where <dn>I</dn> am bringing you, and do not walk in their laws.</dq> [4] <dq>‘Do <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings and guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws, to walk in them. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>‘And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws and <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, which a man does and lives by them. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [6] <dq>‘No one is to approach anyone of his own flesh to uncover his nakedness. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [7] <dq>‘The nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother you do not uncover. She is your mother, you do not uncover her nakedness.</dq> [8] <dq>‘The nakedness of your father’s wife you do not uncover, it is your father’s nakedness.</dq> [9] <dq>‘The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or elsewhere, their nakedness you do not uncover.</dq> [10] <dq>‘The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, their nakedness you do not uncover, for theirs is your own nakedness.</dq> [11] <dq>‘The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten by your father, she is your sister, you do not uncover her nakedness.</dq> [12] <dq>‘The nakedness of your father’s sister you do not uncover, she is your father’s relative.</dq> [13] <dq>‘The nakedness of your mother’s sister you do not uncover, for she is your mother’s relative.</dq> [14] <dq>‘The nakedness of your father’s brother you do not uncover, you do not approach his wife, she is your aunt.</dq> [15] <dq>‘The nakedness of your daughter-in-law you do not uncover, she is your son’s wife, you do not uncover her nakedness.</dq> [16] <dq>‘The nakedness of your brother’s wife you do not uncover, it is your brother’s nakedness.</dq> [17] <dq>‘The nakedness of a woman and her daughter you do not uncover, nor do you take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near of kin, it is wicked.</dq> [18] <dq>‘And do not take a woman as a rival to her sister, to uncover her nakedness while the other is alive.</dq> [19] <dq>‘And do not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness as long as she is separated for her uncleanness.</dq> [20] <dq>‘And do not have intercourse with the wife of your neighbor, to be defiled with her.</dq> [21] <dq>‘And do not give any of your offspring to pass through the fire to Molek, and do not profane <dn>את</dn> the Name of your <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [22] <dq>‘And do not lie with <dn>את</dn> a male as with a woman, it is an abomination.</dq> [23] <dq>‘And do not have intercourse with any beast, to be defiled with it. And a woman does not stand before a beast to mate with it, it is a perversion.</dq> [24] <dq>‘Do not defile yourselves with any of these, for by all these the nations are defiled, which <dn>I</dn> am driving out before you.</dq> [25] <dq>‘Thus the land became defiled, therefore <dn>I</dn> punished it for its crookedness, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.</dq> [26] <dq>‘But you, you shall guard <dn>My</dn> laws and <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, and not do any of these abominations, the native nor the stranger who sojourns among you,</dq> [27] <dq>because the men of the land who were before you have done all these abominations, and thus the land became defiled,</dq> [28] <dq>lest the land vomit <dn>את</dn> you out also when you defile it, as it vomited out <dn>את</dn> the nations that were before you.</dq> [29] <dq>‘For whoever does any of these abominations, the beings who do so shall be cut off from among their people.</dq> [30] <dq>‘And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> charge, so as not to do any of these abominable laws which were done before you, so as not to defile yourselves by them. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: Be Set-Apart
readings.subtitle: Laws for Daily Living
readings.text: [Leviticus 19:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Yisra’el, and say to them, ‘Be set-apart, for <dn>I</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> am set-apart.</dq> [3] <dq>‘Each of you shall fear his mother and his father, and guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [4] <dq>‘Do not turn to idols, and do not make for yourselves molded mighty ones. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>‘And when you offer a slaughtering of peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, offer it for your acceptance.</dq> [6] <dq>‘It is eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. And that which is left on the third day is burned with fire.</dq> [7] <dq>‘And if it is eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable, it is not accepted.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And he who eats it bears his crookedness, because he has profaned <dn>את</dn> the set-apart matters of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And that being shall be cut off from his people.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And when you reap <dn>את</dn> the harvest of your land, do not completely reap the corners of your field, nor gather the gleanings of your harvest.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And do not glean your vineyard, nor gather every grape of your vineyard, leave them for the poor and the stranger. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [11] <dq>‘Do not steal, do not lie, do not deceive one another.</dq> [12] <dq>‘And do not swear falsely by <dn>My</dn> Name and so profane the Name of your <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [13] <dq>‘Do not oppress <dn>את</dn> your neighbor or rob him. The wages of him who is hired is not to remain with you all night until morning.</dq> [14] <dq>‘Do not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling-block before the blind, but fear your <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [15] <dq>‘Do no unrighteousness in right-ruling. Do not be partial to the poor or favor the face of the great, but judge your neighbor in righteousness.</dq> [16] <dq>‘Do not go about as a slanderer among your people. Do not stand against the blood of your neighbor. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [17] <dq>‘Do not hate your brother in your heart. Reprove your neighbor, for certain, and bear no sin because of him.</dq> [18] <dq>‘Do not take vengeance or bear a grudge against the children of your people. And you shall love your neighbor as yourself. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [19] <dq>‘Guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws. Do not let your livestock mate with another kind. Do not sow your field with mixed seed. And a garment which is mixed of linen and wool shall not come upon you.</dq> [20] <dq>‘And when a man has intercourse with a woman who is a female servant, designated for another man, and she has not been ransomed at all nor has freedom been given to her, there is to be an investigation. They are not put to death, because she was not free.</dq> [21] <dq>‘And he shall bring his guilt offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, a ram of guilt offering.</dq> [22] <dq>‘And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for his sin which he has sinned. And the sin which he has sinned shall be forgiven him.</dq> [23] <dq>‘And when you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall reckon their fruit as uncircumcised. For three years it is as uncircumcised to you, it is not eaten.</dq> [24] <dq>‘And in the fourth year all its fruit is set-apart – praises to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [25] <dq>‘And in the fifth year you eat its fruit, so that it yields its increase to you. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [26] <dq>‘Do not eat with the blood. Do not practice divination or magic.</dq> [27] <dq>‘Do not round the corner of your head, nor destroy <dn>את</dn> the corners of your beard.</dq> [28] <dq>‘And do not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor put tattoo marks on you. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [29] <dq>‘Do not profane your daughter by making her a whore, so that the land does not whore, and the land becomes filled with wickedness.</dq> [30] <dq>‘Guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths and reverence <dn>My</dn> set-apart place. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [31] <dq>‘Do not turn to mediums, and do not seek after spiritists to be defiled by them. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [32] <dq>‘Rise up before the gray-headed, and give honor to the face of an old man, and fear your <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [33] <dq>‘And when a stranger sojourns with you in your land, do not oppress him.</dq> [34] <dq>‘Let the stranger who dwells among you be to you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself. For you were strangers in the land of Mitsrayim. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq> [35] <dq>‘Do no unrighteousness in right-ruling, in measurement of length, in weight, or in liquid measure.</dq> [36] <dq>‘Have right scales, right weights, a right ephah, and a right hin. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, who brought <dn>את</dn> you out of the land of Mitsrayim.</dq> [37] <dq>‘And you shall guard <dn>את</dn> all <dn>My</dn> laws and <dn>את</dn> all <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, and do them. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”</dq>
